title: [VIC] Fox ESS CQ7-W Battery & 10kw Hybrid Inverter: 28kwh $6299, 42kwh $7749 Installed (after Rebate) @ Victorian Power Savers
body:
Deal: [VIC] Fox ESS CQ7-W Battery & 10kw Hybrid Inverter: 28kwh $6299, 42kwh $7749 Installed (after Rebate) @ Victorian Power Savers

[adam149] How much for some solar on top of the $7749 ??
Do you install the Foxess Airgate? if so how much?
[Vic Power Savers] Hi Dear, Yes, we have 6.6kw Solar system starting from $1299 Inc Gst and Yes, we do install Airgate, please fill out the given form and someone will contact you next working day with more information of pricing.
[paul04] I have this exact setuo and it's been great. No complaints and it's been great value for money. Sure there are more expensive options which may be slightly better but for me the cost benefit didn't stack up. Maybe GoodWe ESA is a better setup but it's also a fair bit more expensive. I don't understand the hype of Sigenergy, been on the market a similar time to FoxESS and as far as I know have had more recalls and issues…
[M123321] I haven’t heard anything bad about Foxess. Pretty much positive reviews from people who have this installed.
[wpan1] Is it cause shitting on FoxESS will get you more sales?
[JoeRogan] I'm not trying to attract sales. I've not advertised my business and will not on here.
[trotsky] Genuine question as I don't know, what's the issue with this kit? 10kW inverter seems like it would cover my loads, total system size seems good, what wouldn't I get with this system, or what's wrong with it? I am happy to pay for good kit, I shelled out for Fronius over the chinese stuff back in the day and I have my own offgrid Victron gear in my shed, but I don't see much difference nowadays in the home energy system offerings so I can't see why I wouldn't go with a 42kWh FoxESS system at this price?
[Lucille Bluth] Loving my FoxESS setup. No issues, and a thriving community of users on Whirlpool.
Would love to know what these issues are you speak of.
[thousandsuns] If you're going to make an opinion to persuade an audience, at least back it up with facts. Otherwise you just sound like a salty hater.
[JoeRogan] That's the part where you do your own research. That was my advice.
If you do that, and you are happy, by all means go ahead.
Trying to help people and get neg'd for it.
There's a group on facebook called Crap Solar.
It's full of industry people with real life experience.
Add that to your research source. Or not. Like I said, just trying to help.
I wish everybody the best for their solar and battery.
[thousandsuns] Pretty lame still. If you go researching you can find bad things about almost anything. Adds no value whatsoever.
[whichwhatwho] Electrons down a wire. Cheap enough is good enough.
There isn't anything premium in this segment except for software and some edge cases that nobody ever uses.
[cherpu] I and 2 other of my friends have FoxEss solar, battery and ev charger installed and we are really happy with it. Everything integrates together seamlessly and we keep getting regular updates.
If you are in the industry then share specific of what's wrong with FoxEss rather than making a generic statement.
[Kepster] I also have a FoxESS setup, 10kwh hybrid inverter with 42 kWh battery, 7.1 kWh EV charger and a 10.5 Solar array. No problem whatsoever. I like the integration between different components in one app as a bonus.
[unco] Can you do DC coupling for existing solar owners?
[Vic Power Savers] Hi Dear, yes we can do DC coupling with the existing solar system.
[Mortin] @Vic Power Savers
Any deal for the Sigenergy?
[Vic Power Savers] Hi Dear, yes we do have Sigenergy Deal, please fill the form so that we can assist you further.
[jecec] Not sure about mob who replies to you with "Hi Dear". Whats up with that?
